Usage: memoriahub backup schedule [options] [cron]

Manage the automatic backup schedule (cron is computed server-side)

Arguments:
  cron         5-field cron expression, e.g. "0 3 * * *"

Options:
  --tz <iana>  IANA timezone for the schedule (e.g. America/Costa_Rica)
  --show       Show the current schedule
  --disable    Clear the schedule (no more scheduled runs)
  -h, --help   display help for command

Scheduled runs fire from a RUNNING worker-node daemon (`memoriahub node start`),
which polls the server every minute and starts a run when the server-computed
nextRunAt is due. A machine offline at the scheduled time self-heals: the run
fires on the first poll after the daemon is back up.
